name: oloka-video
description: The online foundation for Oloka Video.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @oloka/contracts && npm run build -w @oloka/design-system && npm run build -w @oloka/web && npm run build -w @oloka/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @oloka/server" "npm run dev -w @oloka/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @oloka/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @oloka/design-system && npm run typecheck -w @oloka/server && npm run typecheck -w @oloka/web && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test -w @oloka/server && npm run test -w @oloka/web
